critical_code_review_comments: SocialCircle contact card (frontend): clicking the card body does not navigate to /social/<id>; only the chevron button on the right does. Player@kaeldor test discovered this — using data-testid='contact-card-<id>' as a clickable card would improve discoverability. Currently a keyboard/mouse user must hit the chevron. Minor UX; not blocking.

routes/admin.py GET /admin/job-applications returns {"jobs": [...]} while the review prompt described it as returning the list directly. This is fine (frontend consumes .jobs), but worth documenting in the API contract for consistency with GET/PUT symmetry.

employment.py evaluate_application uses acceptance_base_chance + skill_weight — verified persistence path works. Consider adding a min<=max sanity check on start_hour vs duration in seed_data _std_shifts to guard against future edits creating impossible shift windows (e.g., start_hour>=24).
